name: guarriellocristianmichele
description: supah-skills for Claude Code, Codex and Copilot CLI: the full set, or one skill at a time.

plugins.name: supah-skills
plugins.description: All nine skills: ai-slop-audit, ai-slop-design, ai-slop-prose, buyer-panel, context-audit, doc-truth, mutation-check, orchestrate and supah-help.

plugins.name: ai-slop-audit
plugins.description: Evidence-backed audit and cleanup of needless complexity across a codebase, with GitHub issue publishing.

plugins.name: ai-slop-design
plugins.description: Build pages whose look comes from their subject, and sweep frontend code for design reflexes, contrast failures and duplicated styles, found by a scanner and judged one by one.

plugins.name: ai-slop-prose
plugins.description: Strip AI writing tells from English or Italian prose with a deterministic scanner, then rewrite in the author's voice.

plugins.name: buyer-panel
plugins.description: Test a business idea on a synthetic buyer panel built against agreeable, uniform and over-stated answers, ending with the first real test to run.

plugins.name: context-audit
plugins.description: Measure what every Claude Code session loads, and find instructions, memories and plugins that contradict each other or hold development back.

plugins.name: doc-truth
plugins.description: Check that docs still tell the truth about the repo: links, anchors, commands, flags, scripts, environment variables.

plugins.name: mutation-check
plugins.description: Mutate code, run your own tests, and list the changes they let through: evidence for tautological tests.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Run large jobs inline or on parallel subagents sized to free RAM, with checkpoints and resume.

plugins.name: supah-help
plugins.description: Ask which supah skill or flow fits your situation, and why.

plugins.name: slop-guard
plugins.description: Opt-in hooks: short anti-slop rules at session start, and the ai-slop-prose scanner on every prose file Claude saves.
